stem.text: The warning signal on an ambulance has a frequency of $600\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of sound is $330\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The ambulance is travelling with a constant velocity of $25\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ towards an observer. The ambulance passes, and then moves away from the observer with no change in velocity.

stem.alt: Diagram showing an initial position of ambulance with a right-pointing arrow, an observer dot labelled observer, and a final position of ambulance with a right-pointing arrow.

stem.text: Which overall change in observed frequency takes place between the times at which the ambulance is a long way behind the observer and when it is a long way in front of the observer?
